get_model_from_zoo: get a pretrained Detectron2 model by config path with trained weights loaded onto a device
get_config_from_zoo: get a config object for a model in the model zoo with optional trained weights
get_checkpoint_url: get the S3 download URL for a pretrained model checkpoint given its config path
get_config_file_path: get the filesystem path to a builtin config YAML or Python file from the model zoo
query_model_zoo_url: query the model zoo URL mapping to resolve a config path to its pretrained model URL
